description: A database-agnostic Agentic GraphRAG framework using swappable System One models (local Laya / cloud Jev). A plug-and-play intelligence layer featuring a complete 4-phase pipeline, continuous evaluation and custom A* traversal for any graph database.
summary: Agentic GraphRAG engine using swappable System One decision models (local Laya / cloud Jev). Features a complete 4-phase pipeline (Ingestion, Pre-Retrieval, Traversal, Post-Retrieval) and evaluation across Neo4j, Memgraph, Apache AGE, and Kùzu driven by a custom A* traversal algorithm.
